title: Karaoke Studio v2.1.4 (Black Screen Fix & Low-End TV Reliability)
changelog: 🛡️ Black Screen Fix: TV app boots fully in the background with a startup watchdog — no more frozen black stage on low-end boxes
🖥️ Renderer Crash Recovery: WebView automatically rebuilds after a GPU renderer crash instead of staying blank forever
🔁 Smart Reload Backoff: capped, spaced-out page retries eliminate the infinite reload loop on flaky Wi-Fi
🎬 Background Video Guard: dead BGV videos retry a max of 4 times then fall back to photo mode
✨ Low-Spec TV Mode: devices with ≤2GB RAM automatically freeze decorative animations and drop heavy GPU filters
🧠 Memory Leak Fixes: LRU MIDI cache, file-descriptor leak patch, and atomic queue updates for smooth 24/7 sessions
🎵 Reliable Seek & Resume: RFC-correct range streaming; lyric timings now follow the tempo/key shift
